ask_y.reply: A simple Yes/No is not an accurate way to describe the impact of the Cuban Revolution. Outcomes varied greatly over time and by metric — e.g., health and education indicators improved significantly for many Cubans, while political freedoms, economic opportunities and personal liberties were sharply curtailed for others. Historians generally debate the trade-offs rather than reach a single binary verdict.
